summary: Added three ECS rules to the cfn-lint repo, nothing committed. E3052 (TaskFargateNetworkMode) requires NetworkMode awsvpc on FARGATE task definitions. E3053 (ServiceFargateNetworkConfiguration) requires NetworkConfiguration on FARGATE-launch services. E3054 (TaskFargateCpuMemoryRequired) requires task-level Cpu and Memory on FARGATE task definitions. Each has a JSON schema, a unit test file, and a row in docs/rules.md. The rule choice was mine since the spec didn't name them. E3054 overlaps with existing E3048 (duplicate messages on missing Cpu/Memory); I kept it to meet the three-rule request and can drop it if preferred. ECS and rule-collection tests pass (87). Full unit suite: 1529 passed, 1 failed (test_build_graph, needs pygraphviz/pydot, not in the venv); test_formatters.py could not be collected (defusedxml missing from the venv). I ran tests with PYTHONPATH pointing at this repo's src because the venv's cfnlint is an editable install from another directory; the venv was not modified. An end-to-end run on a sample Fargate template produced all three new rule errors.
